blocks.text: Streaming platform Netflix on Wednesday, Oct. 7, unveiled the official cast lineup for “Solo Leveling,” starring Byeon Woo-seok, with Hallyu megastars Han So-hee and Jung Ji-hoon — better known by his stage name Rain — joining the cast. “Solo Leveling” is the streaming service’s live-action adaptation of one of Korea’s most popular intellectual properties. The franchise began as a web novel of the same name and grew into a global hit before expanding into a webtoon, anime series and games.
